nodes.description: mapping (address => uint256) balances: ledger of token holdings, mutated by transfer/transferFrom and initialized in the ERC20Token constructor.
mapping (address => mapping (address => uint256)) allowed: nested spender allowance ledger written by approve/approveAndCall and decremented by transferFrom.
uint256 public totalSupply: total token amount, set once in the ERC20Token constructor.
string public name: human readable token name ("Rainbow Token").
uint8 public decimals: display precision of the token (18).
string public symbol: token ticker ("RNBO").
string public version: arbitrary versioning string ("H1.1").
Abstract declaration of totalSupply() returning uint256; contains no body in the Token interface.
Abstract declaration of balanceOf(address _owner) constant returning uint256; no body.
Abstract declaration of transfer(address _to, uint256 _value); no body, overridden by StandardToken.
Abstract declaration of transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value); no body, overridden by StandardToken.
Abstract declaration of approve(address _spender, uint256 _value); no body, overridden by StandardToken.
Abstract declaration of allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returning uint256; no body.
function transfer(address _to, uint256 _value) returns (bool): moves _value from balances[msg.sender] to balances[_to] after a balance check that only verifies _value > 0.
function transferFrom(address _from, address _to, uint256 _value) returns (bool): moves tokens using the allowance of msg.sender and decrements allowed[_from][msg.sender].
function balanceOf(address _owner) constant returns (uint256): read-only accessor over balances.
function approve(address _spender, uint256 _value) returns (bool): overwrites allowed[msg.sender][_spender] and emits Approval.
function allowance(address _owner, address _spender) constant returns (uint256): read-only accessor over allowed.
function () { throw; }: bare fallback that reverts on any plain ether transfer to the token contract.
function ERC20Token(): constructor that mints 450000...000 tokens to msg.sender, sets totalSupply to 900000...000, and writes name/decimals/symbol.
function approveAndCall(address _spender, uint256 _value, bytes _extraData): sets the allowance then performs a low-level _spender.call to receiveApproval(...) without any reentrancy protection.
Caller-controlled address used for balance ownership, allowance keying, constructor minting and as an argument of the external receiveApproval call.
Subtraction balances[msg.sender] -= _value inside StandardToken.transfer; unchecked arithmetic allows underflow on the sender balance.
Addition balances[_to] += _value inside StandardToken.transfer; unchecked arithmetic allows balance wrap-around.
Addition balances[_to] += _value inside StandardToken.transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic allows balance wrap-around.
Subtraction balances[_from] -= _value inside StandardToken.transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on an attacker-chosen account.
Subtraction allowed[_from][msg.sender] -= _value inside StandardToken.transferFrom; unchecked arithmetic on the allowance ledger.
Low-level _spender.call(...) inside approveAndCall: unchecked external call to an attacker-controlled address returning no value check and no reentrancy guard.
_to of StandardToken.transfer: arbitrary recipient address.
_value of StandardToken.transfer: caller-supplied amount used in unchecked subtraction/addition.
_from of StandardToken.transferFrom: source address chosen by the caller.
_to of StandardToken.transferFrom: arbitrary recipient address.
_value of StandardToken.transferFrom: caller-supplied amount used in unchecked arithmetic.
_spender of StandardToken.approve: address granted the allowance.
_value of StandardToken.approve: allowance amount written to allowed.
_owner of StandardToken.balanceOf: address whose balance is read.
_owner of StandardToken.allowance: owner key of the allowance lookup.
_spender of StandardToken.allowance: spender key of the allowance lookup.
_spender of ERC20Token.approveAndCall: approval target and recipient of the low-level call.
_value of ERC20Token.approveAndCall: allowance amount and argument forwarded to receiveApproval.
_extraData of ERC20Token.approveAndCall: attacker-controlled bytes forwarded verbatim into the external call.

edges.reason: msg.sender indexes balances in StandardToken.transfer and therefore controls which balance is debited.
msg.sender is the spender key in allowed[_from][msg.sender] in StandardToken.transferFrom.
msg.sender is used as the owner key when writing allowed[msg.sender][_spender] in approve.
msg.sender receives the entire initial mint in the ERC20Token constructor.
msg.sender is the approval owner and is forwarded as the _from argument of receiveApproval.
msg.sender indexes the allowance entry that is decremented in transferFrom.
msg.sender is passed as a calldata argument into the low-level _spender.call.
Caller-supplied _value is subtracted from balances[msg.sender] without overflow/underflow protection.
Caller-supplied _value is added to balances[_to] without a wrap-around check.
_to selects which balance is credited in StandardToken.transfer.
Attacker-chosen _from selects the balance that is decremented, enabling underflow of that account.
Caller-supplied _value is added to balances[_to] in transferFrom without a wrap-around check.
Caller-supplied _value is subtracted from balances[_from] in transferFrom without a wrap-around check.
_to selects the credited balance in StandardToken.transferFrom.
Caller-supplied _value is subtracted from the allowance entry, permitting allowance underflow.
_from selects the allowance owner key that is decremented.
The caller-supplied _spender is the target of the low-level call, letting an attacker contract execute arbitrary code.
_value is forwarded as an argument of the receiveApproval call.
_extraData is forwarded verbatim into the external call payload.
The subtraction is executed inside StandardToken.transfer when the guard passes.
The credit addition is executed inside StandardToken.transfer immediately after the debit.
The recipient credit is executed inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
The source debit is executed inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
The allowance decrement is executed inside StandardToken.transferFrom.
The unchecked external call is the last statement of approveAndCall, executed after the allowance is already credited.
StandardToken.transfer reads and writes the balances mapping.
StandardToken.transferFrom reads and writes the balances mapping.
StandardToken.transferFrom reads and decrements the allowed mapping.
balanceOf only reads balances.
approve writes allowed[msg.sender][_spender].
allowance only reads the allowed mapping.
The constructor assigns the full initial balance to msg.sender in balances.
The constructor assigns totalSupply.
The constructor writes the name field.
The constructor writes the decimals field.
The constructor writes the symbol field.
approveAndCall writes the allowance into allowed[msg.sender][_spender] before the external call.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the balances mapping.
The unchecked addition mutates the balances mapping.
The unchecked addition mutates the balances mapping.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the balances mapping.
The unchecked subtraction mutates the nested allowed mapping.
An attacker contract invoked as _spender can re-enter transferFrom using the allowance that was granted just before the call, draining the approver's tokens.
The external call target can re-enter transfer during the callback window because no reentrancy guard or state finalization exists.
Token.transfer interface declaration is implemented/overridden by StandardToken.transfer.
Token.transferFrom interface declaration is implemented/overridden by StandardToken.transferFrom.
Token.balanceOf interface declaration is implemented/overridden by StandardToken.balanceOf.
Token.approve interface declaration is implemented/overridden by StandardToken.approve.

normalization_plan.reason: _to is a pure input of StandardToken.transfer and only serves to select the credited balance, so it is folded into the enclosing function node.
_value is the value operand of the unchecked debit/credit pair in StandardToken.transfer and carries no independent identity beyond that function.
_from is only used as the key for balances/allowed inside StandardToken.transferFrom and should be absorbed by the function node.
_to of transferFrom is a transient recipient selector local to StandardToken.transferFrom.
_value of transferFrom only feeds the three unchecked arithmetic operations of that function and is merged into it.
_spender exists solely as the allowance key of StandardToken.approve and is merged into the approve node.
_value of approve is the value written to allowed and has no meaning outside StandardToken.approve.
_owner is a read-only lookup key inside StandardToken.balanceOf and is folded into that accessor.
_owner is a read-only lookup key inside StandardToken.allowance and is folded into that accessor.
_spender is a read-only lookup key inside StandardToken.allowance and is folded into that accessor.
_spender of approveAndCall is the direct target of the low-level call, so it is best represented as part of the unsafe external-call node.
_value is forwarded straight into the receiveApproval external call payload and is absorbed by the unsafe-call node.
_extraData is passed verbatim as call data to the untrusted target and therefore belongs to the unsafe-call node.
